data.exact_reserve_text: The net underwriting loss of GBP 36,223k includes the anticipated impact of the recent announcement from the Ministry of Justice, reducing the statutory discount rate applied to certain UK personal injury claims (referred to as Ogden tables) to -0.75%. This impact primarily arose from sub-Syndicate 566's casualty treaty account.

prior_year_events.impact_description: reducing the statutory discount rate applied to certain UK personal injury claims (referred to as Ogden tables) to -0.75%. This impact primarily arose from sub-Syndicate 566's casualty treaty account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance of long tail outstanding claims
prior_year_events.impact_description: During the year the syndicate entered into a significant transaction with a third party organisation, whereby, in return for a reinsurance premium, the syndicate benefits from 100% reinsurance of certain long tail outstanding claims on 2014 and prior underwriting years. This policy removes reserve uncertainty applicable to the reinsured claims, and is due to be followed by legal transfer of the underlying claims to the reinsurer.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 283.832 million, primarily driven by adverse development across various underwriting years. This strengthening was notably influenced by the announcement of a reduction in the Ogden discount rate to -0.75%, which increased liabilities for certain UK personal injury claims, particularly within the casualty treaty account. Additionally, the syndicate entered into a reinsurance transaction for long-tail outstanding claims from 2014 and prior underwriting years to reduce net reserve uncertainty.
